title: Why Are X Accounts Suddenly Losing So Many Followers? | Explainers News - News18
text: Canadian singer Justin Bieber recently posted adorable photos with his wife, model Hailey Bieber, on X. While Bieber’s post seemed nothing out of the ordinary, fellow users and fans on the Elon Musk-owned social platform were quick to wonder if the star was “follower hunting". Why would a wildly popular celebrity such as Bieber care about followers, you ask? X users began noticing a massive decline in Bieber’s follower count. They instantly chalked up theories. “someone said he’s losing followers and I thought it was one of those banger hunting posts but it’s real wtf he was at 94M yesterday (sic)," an X user, quoting Bieber’s couple pic, remarked. Were some sinister powers in play? Bieber fans noticed the sharp decline in his followers only after he shared photos with his wife, Hailey, on 28 November. “Ever since this user made this post, his followers have been reducing. It’s insane. What’s happening fr? (sic)" The online conspiracy theories were just about to subside, but Bieber hilariously flipped off the entire X community without giving any context or attaching a caption to his fresh post. “I know Elon musk is planning to ban this account (sic)," a user quoted Bieber, wondering if the Canadian singer had fallen off massively. According to the screenshots flashing on X, Bieber’s earlier follower count stood between 109 and 110 million. On December 4, the singer’s follower count had plummeted to below 90 million. Keeping all the conspiracy theories aside, Bieber was neither being targeted by mysterious forces nor was X platform trying to settle any scores with him. Veteran Indian actor Anupam Kher recently took to X and tagged its chief, Elon Musk, to address the drop in his followers count. According to Kher, he had witnessed 9,00,000 followers wiped from his X account in the past two weeks or so. “Dear Mr. @elonmusk ! I have lost more than 9 followers in the last 15days! Will you know the reason! Or anybody in your team? By the way this is an OBSERVATION, not a COMPLAINT! Yet (sic)." Are celebrities being cancelled en masse? Not really. An X account, keeping tabs on celeb X accounts, noted a steep decline in followers of Taylor Swift, Katy Perry, Nicky Minaj, to name a few. In fact, according to X’s Trending tab, football star Cristiano Ronaldo had seen as many as 7 million followers depart from his account. The recent diminishing of followers is no coincidence. In October, Nikita Bier, the head of product at X (as per their bio), shared about a clean-up drive being conducted on X. “This week we purged 1.7 million bots engaging in reply spam. You should start noticing improvements in the coming days. We will be focusing on DM spam next," Bier informed. Musk has, in fact, been vocal about bots plaguing his platform in the past and vowed to clean up the mess on his platform. Also Read: Elon Musk’s X Finally Ready To Cleanup A Huge Spam Problem: What It Says Apart from Bier, there was no word from Musk on the bot issue. When an X user tagged Musk’s in-house AI Grok and quizzed about the spam bots running amok on the platform, the chatbot wrote: “I’m Grok, an AI built by xAI. X is actively removing bots—in October 2025, they purged 1.7 million reply spam bots, with more cleanups planned for DMs. Elon Musk has emphasized fighting bots since acquiring the platform. Spotting them easily highlights the challenge; report suspicious accounts to help X’s efforts."
